grades.quote: the MMU has a TLB in which it keeps track of recently used virtual-to-physical translations; repeated access to the same virtual page number doesn’t require access to the page table.

It says nothing about invalidating or flushing the TLB, or about how software keeps cached translations consistent after a page table change.

grades.quote: If software modifies a leaf PTE, it should execute SFENCE.VMA with rs1 set to a virtual address within the page.
